<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial intervention:</strong> A Supreme Court bench led by the CJI is set to hear a plea from Rahul Gandhi and INDIA bloc leaders challenging the SIR this Thursday.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Cabinet resignation:</strong> Union Minister L Murugan has resigned from his position as Minister of State and as a member of the Rajya Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOZ3VSX2hYUDRFYXVaeGR6UVZZNnBoR1B5U0NvaHpFR3VFNjQ4bDFyTmhjbVY2RHRKcDlUcE9WX0Nla2xJWkpwN2xoXzcySVdsQUtZbzRISHNBY2Rtc3VCZlQ5Y3dSVVpweG1zUWJyUVNTWEkzcWNsb2pKSXNvRFJSSDA1b2xuQVlBWlJ4a3d0ak1WWU5HUnRn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Protest and rhetoric:</strong> Rahul Gandhi met with the parents of Ankita Bhandari at India Gate to criticize the BJP, while Asaduddin Owaisi labeled the INDIA bloc an &quot;elite club&quot; regarding the ongoing protests against the SIR.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election integrity:</strong> The Supreme Court has reprimanded the Election Commission of India for failing to produce missing footage from the 2023 Sringeri polls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Banking reforms:</strong> Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman defended the NDA’s banking reforms and the IDBI Bank stake sale in response to criticism from Akhilesh Yadav.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
</ul>
